title: Total Terraforming trait evidence and controlled observation

provenance.location: TOPICPOS 1818636 (0x001bc00c), HLP file offset 458241 (0x0006fe01), topic 270 'Total Terraforming'
provenance.note: Decoded help topic for Total Terraforming; documented-only claim, not a runtime observation.

provenance.location: dialog #150 resource at file offset 0x2fab00, candidate control 292 (caption empty; position-based lead only); no literal 'Total Terraforming' ASCII string was found in the executable by exact-byte search
provenance.note: Executable location of the trait name/control is a lead; it does not prove runtime mechanics.

setup.baseline: A custom race with no other selected trait and otherwise identical wizard choices.
setup.variable: Select only Total Terraforming and record the advantage-point balance and observable effects.
setup.universe: Single-player, fixed small universe with one Turindrones opponent if the runtime exposes it (otherwise record the actual opponent), fixed difficulty, no random events; keep the same seed/settings across trials.

procedure: Create the baseline race and record the step 1-6 settings and advantage-point balance.
Create the same race with only Total Terraforming changed; record the exact advantage-point balance and any disabled controls.
Start the game and record starting technology, planets, fleets, installations and available catalog entries.
Run a controlled comparison for each documented effect, varying one input at a time and repeating at least three trials where randomness may apply.
Record the observed result, game year, settings and any discrepancy from the documented claim.

documented: Starts able to adjust each environmental attribute by up to 3% in either direction (documented-only).
Can research terraforming technologies up to 30% instead of the normal 15% (documented-only).
Terraforming requires only Biotechnology research rather than Biotechnology plus a second field (documented-only).

unresolved: The 30% resource reduction rounding is unknown.
The 3% starting cap and 30% maximum are documented but not runtime-verified.
Interaction with immunity and Claim Adjuster temporary terraforming is unknown.
notes: The help is dated January 1998 and its applicability to stars26i.exe is unverified. No original-game execution is claimed by PR2.
